jobs.title: e006 zhengting day
jobs.prompt: Edit image 1 into the same hall on a clear morning: both hanging lanterns are switched off and unlit; bright pale-gold morning sunlight comes in from the lattice doors on the right wall and falls across the floor and the long table; the walls are lit by daylight. Turn the tall grandfather clock on the left a little so its face is not readable. Remove the small side desk and the picture frame on the left wall, leaving plain wall. Keep the long table, the chairs, the pillars, the doors and the layout exactly the same. One long table only. Photorealistic, morning daylight, no text anywhere.

jobs.title: e006 fanting fix
jobs.prompt: Edit image 1: remove the cupboard at the left front so only the one cupboard on the back right remains; make all the windows black night glass with nothing visible outside; make the doorway at the back dark, the courtyard beyond it black, with no lamp and no light outside. Keep the long dining table, the chairs, the hanging lamp lit over the table and everything else the same; a few white bowls and pairs of chopsticks on the table. Night, warm indoor light only, no text anywhere. Photorealistic.

jobs.title: e006 tray prop
jobs.prompt: Using the tray, teapot and cups of image 1 as the design, a prop photograph on a plain neutral grey background, seen from a slightly high angle: a plain rectangular light wooden tray about the size of a magazine, unpainted natural wood, holding one small round purple-clay (yixing) teapot with a short spout and three small plain white porcelain teacups without handles, the tea in them pale gold. No hands, no desk, nothing else, no cloth, no text, no pattern on the cups. Photorealistic product photo, soft even light.
